findings.evidence: Exact-head blocker: the original fix validated the compiled outcome only after SmartPromptMachine.compile_task had already minted a signed PromptAutomationEnvelope, so a non-READY/artifact-less build was still wrapped into an envelope in memory before rejection. The READY+artifact gate now lives inside compile_task immediately before _issue_prompt_automation_envelope and raises PromptTaskUnreadyError first; test_envelope_issuance_seam_never_runs_for_a_non_ready_build proves the issuance/signing function is not called for INSUFFICIENT_BUDGET, REPLAN_REQUIRED, READY-without-artifact, or another non-READY outcome, the P1 reproduction proves no fallback dispatch and no DISPATCHED/COMPLETED ledger state, and test_envelope_issuance_seam_runs_exactly_once_for_a_genuinely_ready_build proves a READY build still invokes the seam exactly once with unchanged envelope identity.

Post-merge P1 on PR #438 / Issue #436, and the frame for this repair: raw task_text below the ingress byte ceiling expanded beyond the available budget after the machine rendered JSON/spec/context, yet the build could still be wrapped into an envelope and proceed toward handoff/dispatch. With the seam-level gate this is impossible: non-READY builds are refused before the envelope seam, and the issue-agent reproduction proves no dispatch and no successful execution record on the failure.

Fixing the blocker might have introduced a second renderer or a duplicate budget authority that re-measures rendered size instead of accepting the machine's own outcome. Both the machine gate and the ingress invariant read allocation.outcome and manifest.prompt_artifact_id directly from the PromptCompilationResult the machine produced; no parallel renderer or duplicate pricing exists, and the source regression still pins both production callers through the one ingress.

Raw-size-only validation could recur elsewhere in the engineering surface. DFF-018 is added with scope src/hunter/evidence_intelligence/ and the seam + fail-closed + P1 regressions as evidence; the preflight guard recomputes applicable families from changed paths on every push, so any future engineering ingress path that bypasses the compiled-outcome gate is review-blocked.

A fail-closed rejection without a deterministic machine-readable reason would leave callers and automation unable to distinguish INSUFFICIENT_BUDGET from other non-READY outcomes. PromptTaskUnreadyError carries ENGINEERING_TASK_NOT_READY key=value text plus structured fields, and the deterministic identity of the reason across repeated compiles is asserted.
